claim: Small molecules targeting GRK6, PTK6, MAP3K11, GPR183, GART, and SIK1 inhibited T cell activation in the nanomolar to micromolar range.
source: To determine whether these V2G-implicated genes are novel regulators of T cell activation, we used commercially available pharmacological modulators in dose–response assays of activation-induced T cell proliferation. Stimulation of T cells in the presence of ligands for CHRNB1, KISS1R and OXER1 did not significantly affect T cell proliferation; however, small molecules targeting GRK6, PTK6, MAP3K11, GPR183, GART, and SIK1 inhibited T cell activation in the nanomolar to micromolar range (Figure 8G).
evidence: Result from pharmacological validation experiments shown in Figure 8G
